cues.text: Outside Hagakure, the ramen shop in the strip mall. Shinjiro steps out through the shop's sliding door and stops facing Akihiko, who stands waiting with a hand on his hip.
Shinjiro shakes his head, shoves his hands in his pockets, turns away and takes a few steps off. Akihiko turns after him.
Shinjiro stands with his head lowered. At the far end of the walkway, Ken comes into view and stops.
Ken's eyes widen. He hurries a few steps closer and stands quietly by a signboard, listening, unseen by the two of them.
Shinjiro turns and walks away down the walkway, leaving Akihiko standing outside the shop.
